buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Text Based ATC i. Bidders are required to submit EMD Rs. 3,88,436/- in favour of Munitions Indi a Limited O. F. Khamaria .Exemption will be given to the sellers as defined at Para m of GeM GTC 4.0 (Version 1.28) dated 22.12.2025. or latest version of GeM. Bidder should have registered in major NIC code “78” (Human resource s provision and management of human resources functions) in Udyam Registr ation Certificate for EMD exemption. EMD/PSD may be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or Bank Guarantee from any of the commer cial banks and it should be drawn in the favor of CGM or payment online in an acceptable form and the same shall be uploaded by seller in the online bid an d hard copy of the same instrument (except online payment) will have to be s ubmitted directly to the buyer within following time limit: (#) Hard copy of the EMD (Bid security) will have to be submitted directly to the buyer within 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be tr eated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bid by buyer without makin g any reference to the seller. (#) Hard copy of the Performance security deposit (PSD) will have to be sub mitted directly to the buyer within 30 days of award of contract on GeM Portal. It is advised that EMD may be submitted through online payment in favor of be neficiary details as given below to avoid postal delays & bank formalities asso ciated with generation and submission of instruments other than online payme nt. If the seller submits the EMD through online payment mode, then seller shal l upload the documentary proof of online payment of EMD along with online bid submission. Further it is also advised that PSD may be submitted through online payment mode after award of contract on GeM Portal in favor CGM, beneficiary details a s given below, and also Indemnity Bonds may be accepted as performance sec urity deposit from central/State PSUs. If seller submit the PSD through online p ayment mode, then seller shall upload the documentary proof of online payme nt of PSD at GeM Portal. Account Name : Munitions India Limited O F Khamaria Account No. : 40436892598 IFSC : SBIN0003228 MICR : 482002006 Bank address : STATE BANK OF INDIA, RANJHI ii. In I In case of any clarification bidder can enquire through e-mail i.e. ofkpvgrp 8@ord.gov.in OR call at 0761-2742137. iii. For “Geographic Presence” Vendor has to submit GST Certificate with head offi ce location in Jabalpur District. Firms who have not submitted the complete set of GST Certificate with head office in Jabalpur District, their offer will be rejecte d. iv. Firm must have executed at least one supply order of minimum Rs. 1,03,58,3 14.00, or two supply order of Rs. 64,73,946.25 ​or three supply order of Rs. 51, 79,157.00 for providing similar service i.e. manpower supply to any Central Go vernment/State Government or Public Sector Undertaking in the last 03 years.

Relevant documents i.e. copy of Contract Order and Execution Certificate/Job C ompletion Certificate are to be uploaded by the bidder along with bid. (MSEs & Startups are exempted). v. Average annual turnover of the bidder for the last 03 years ending on 31st Mar ch of preceding year (2026) must be at least Rs. 38,84,367.75 lakhs. Bidders s hall submit Certificate from registered CA indicating the turnover details for las t 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) along with bid in support of financial c apability. (MSEs & Startups are exempted). vi. Bidders have to submit latest copy of registration certificates of MSME certifica te along with bid. vii. Bidders should submit copy of registration certificates of EPF & ESIC along wit h bid. viii. Bidder should submit the sealed & signed copy of scope of work and terms & c onditions. ix. Note to Bidders – Participating bidders may please be noted that GeM Portal is having functionality to monitor bids having same IP address used by bidders / sellers. GeM portal is capturing and reflecting the IP address used by buyers and participated bidders / sellers. The received bids having matching / commo n IP address with other participating bidders / sellers or buyer, then their offer will be out rightly rejected and will not be considered for further evaluation. x. Sub-contracting/Sub-letting with the permission of the buyer: Seller sh all not be entitled without buyers prior return consent to sub contract/sub-let t o a third party all or part of the benefits or obligations of the contract (Even by way of change of ownership or control), except as expressly permitted in this c ontract if any, to subcontract any of its right and interest under this contract. xi. TPC deliberated that as per MIL directives vide Lt. No. MIL/HR/2024-25 Dt. 13/0 8/2024, clause “Near- relationship certificate that none of his/her relative is wo rking in the Unit where he/she is going to bid for the tender. The near relative f or this purpose should be well define in the tender’’ may be incorporated in thi s tender.“The Bidder/Tender shall disclose whether any relative of the bidder /t enderer, it proprietor, partner director or person having a controlling or materi al interest in the firm is employed with or associated with the procuring entity. Near relative shall mean a person related by blood, marriage or legal relations hip, including spouse, father, mother, son, daughter, brother, sister and such o ther relatives as may be specified under the applicable rules of the procuring e ntity. The Bidder/Tenderer shall submit a declaration conforming above. Any n on-disclosure or incorrect declaration may be dealt with in accordance with the applicable tender conditions and rules of procuring entity”. xii. Service provider have to follow recently implemented four labour codes effecti ve from 21st Nov. 2025. xiii. The person being deploy should have PVR (Police Verification Report) which is valid for 01 years. xiv. The person being deploy having Adhar card linked with mobile no. xv. Service Provider shall provide PPEs as per Sr. No. 15 of ANNEXURE TO GEM SL A. xvi. Firm should depute 30 nos. (01 Tailor Skilled, 10 Cook Semi-skilled, 05 Washer man (Dhobi) Semi-skilled, 01 Masalchi Semi-skilled, 04 Barber Semi-skilled, 02 EBR Semi-skilled, 01 Mess waiter Un-skilled, 06 Sweeper Un-skilled) manpower on daily basis. Further the person being deployed shall be continued and shoul d not be changed without prior permission of the buyer. xvii. Since GeM portal does not have facility to feed exactly 05-year experience for skilled tailor and 04-year experience for semi-skilled Cook, Washerman, Barber , EBR & Masalchi, hence bidders must ensure minimum 05 year of working exp

erience for skilled and 04 year of working experience for semi-skilled with supp orting documents during deployment. xviii. Bidders has to comply other term & condition as mentioned in uploaded ANNE XURE TO GEM SLA and GeM SLA. xix. Payment shall be made on monthly basis. xx. Buyer reserve the right to suspend/cancel/shortclose the contract at any time without assigning any reason. xxi. Performance Security Deposit (PSD) is to be furnished by the successful bidder within 30 days after placement of contract. If the firm fails to submit the PSD w ithin the specified date, it shall be treated as an unreliable firm and shall be go verned as per existing guidelines on penalties issued by MoD/MIL/GeM. xxii. Price Variation Clause is applicable. In case of any changes in the minimu m wages as per the Applicable Laws during the Contract period, Buyer shall pa y the Service Provider the difference in wage from the amount mentioned in th e contract on pro rata basis. xxiii. Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the documents/ certificates sought in the tender along with the bid. xxiv. Also bidder has to arrange rain coat, umbrella, winter jacket etc. whenever req uired for his worker. No extra charge shall be claimed by service provider for t hese items. xxv. Bidders has to timely pay salary to its worker i.e. on or before 7th of succeedi ng month. xxvi. Bidder has to provide monthly salary slip and ID card to its worker. xxvii. If the workers are employed on national holiday,double salary on that day has t o be paid by the contractor. xxviii. Contractor must have valid Labour License. xxix. As per Govt. guidelines, weekly off will be given to the workers after 06 workin g days. Accordingly, the workers will be paid maximum 26/27 mandays in a m onth and alternate manpower will be provided by the contractor against the w orkers on weekly off. Thus, TPC opined that delivery period will be one year i.e. 360 working days from the date of placement of supply order. xxx. Payment Terms & Penalty clause:- As per GeM SLA and ANNEXURE TO GEM SLA. Option Clause – The buyer reserves the right to increase/decrease the duration up to 25% at the time of placement of contract at the prevailing rate. The buyer a lso reserves the right to increase the duration by up to 25% during the currency o f the contract at the prevailing rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders.In ca se of multi L-1 offers, “Run L-1 Selection” tool provided by GeM system may be used and the contract will be awarded to GeM system selected L-1 firm with exist ing terms & conditions. . 3.
